name: BMP-3
protection: Aluminium hull with steel appliqué, optional ERA/slat kits. Game: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R damages optics; 12.7/14.5 mm penetrates sides; any launcher kills.
visual_notes: Low boxy hull with flat sloped glacis; engine at the rear, troops exit over the engine through two rear doors and roof hatches
Small low turret with the stubby 100 mm gun and long thin 30 mm cannon side by side
6 road wheels per side, amphibious trim vane folded on the nose
2026 Russian: anti-drone cage over the turret and roof, slat panels on hull sides, netting
